scope: bounded first tranche of already-local or owned synthetic evidence; no bulk download and no external media acquisition

license_policy.note: An annotation-card license does not clear underlying media. Every admitted asset needs its own license decision and provenance record.

split_assignment.note: The split is a deterministic function of group_key alone, so one source group can never straddle train/development/audit.

dedup.note: Only exact byte hashes are checked. Perceptual or near-duplicate detection is not claimed.

checks: a group_key may map to exactly one split
a group_key may not appear under two source ids
an explicit declared_split must equal the computed split
evaluation-only source ids are never admitted

source_pins.note: Pinned research candidate. No media was downloaded or cleared by this task.
Pinned research candidate. Human narration and model-rewritten captions are not cleared media.
Mirror-level card license does not join each per-file license. Pinned candidate only.
Speaker/chapter groups must remain intact. Pinned candidate only.

synthetic_fixtures.label: owned_synthetic_not_external_media
synthetic_fixtures.note: These files are authored for tests and protocol replay. They are not recordings, images or videos from any external dataset and carry no external license.

stop_rules.action: stop admitting every asset from that source
stop_rules.trigger: revision mismatch, disallowed license, missing provenance or hash/size failure
one group_key maps to more than one split or source, or an explicit split conflicts

stop_rules.action: stop admitting further assets and mark the receipt stopped
stop admitting further assets from that source

stop_rules.trigger: no real source is gate-cleared; only owned synthetic fixtures may be admitted

non_claims: No external image, audio, video or annotation asset was acquired, cleared or audited.
No dataset loader, model or native job was executed.
Synthetic fixtures are repository-owned test evidence, not licensed external media.
Tranche admission is a protocol decision, not training admission or quality evidence.
